This berry is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in deciduous or mixed forests, and is best known in south-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is consumed directly.

This berry from the Suza Sumar yields a concentrated juice: eight ounces restore 2–20 concussion hits. Roughly two large buckets of berries are needed for one dose, which keeps for six months.
